task: Higashiosaka slice H1: implement the Action Core battle system (spec section 2) and its battle UI (spec section 5) in the existing battle engine, with generic engine/UI tests on a test-only encounter. No Higashiosaka enemy data, encounters, region or story yet (that is H2).
requirements: Read .ai/higashiosaka-spec.md sections 2, 5, 9 and 11 first (section 11 = what H0 already built: the actionCore sprite prop, the frozen Core plate markup and CSS in rpg.css, the .battle-intent__aim tag). Read DESIGN_DECISIONS.md (Yao balance correction, H0 entry).

Freeze and implement exactly: encounter `core: { hp }` -> state.core = { hp, maxHp } (null when absent); persists across waves of one battle, full on every new battle and retry; not saved in checkpoints.

enemy.aim = 'hero' | 'core' chosen together with each intent from enemy data (`aim: 'core'` -> every damaging intent aims at the Core; `heavyAim: 'core'` -> charge and heavy aim at the Core, normal attacks at the hero; default hero; always hero when there is no Core). The aim never changes between telegraph and action.

resolveEnemyPhase: an attack/heavy aimed at the Core subtracts defendedDamage(amount, action) from core.hp (hero Guard/Barrier reduce, Dodge follows its normal rules), event { type: 'damage', target: 'core', source, amount }; the ally protect rule does not apply; a Core-aimed heavy met by Guard/Barrier refunds AP exactly like a heavy on the hero (existing once-per-phase defense refund).

core.hp reaching 0 loses the battle immediately, even mid-phase: { type: 'lost', reason: 'core' }, message 'アクション・コアが こわれた！ THE CORE IS BROKEN!'. Hero death still loses as before. Retry assist unchanged; Core full on each attempt.

Core charge: at the start of every coreChargeEvery-th player turn (default 3) when core.hp > coreChargeAbove * maxHp (default 0.5) the hero gains +1 AP via gainAp(..., 'core') with message 'アクション・コア チャージ！ +1 AP'. Export pure helpers coreThreats(state) and coreChargeDue(state).

Generalise the Yao protector rule to data: `protects: 'callers'` (Armored Orc, behaviour byte-identical) or `protects: 'coreAttackers'` (first living enemy with aim 'core' or heavyAim 'core', else a boss). Existing Orc data must keep working (default to 'callers' if absent).

Repair: ai.support 'repair' chooses `repair` when a living `machine: true` enemy other than itself is damaged; resolving heals it by data.repair; event { type: 'repair', source, target, amount }; telegraphed like heal ('🔧 REPAIR / なおす'). Ninja Strike's OPENING list gains 'repair'. Sprite hooks: repair intent rests in 'cast'; eventSpriteStates repair -> [[source, 'cast']].

UI (src/battle-ui.js): render the Core with the exact markup documented in the rpg.css 'Action Core' comment and spec section 11 (.battle-field--core, .battle-core--{idle|hit|charge|broken|low}, plate with hpBar + battle-hp--core, battleArt('actionCore', row) where broken uses the 'tired' row). Hit state on core damage events, charge state on the core AP gain, low below 35%, broken on core loss. Core damage floater on the Core. Core-aimed intents append → コア. Hints in battleHint after the existing heavy/boom/low-HP checks: Core-aimed heavy -> '🛡 コアが ねらわれている！ まもろう！ GUARD THE CORE!' (highlights defence); a living aim:'core' enemy -> 'コアを こわす てきを さきに たおそう！'; Core below 35% -> 'コアが ピンチ！ まもろう！'. repair event message '🔧 なおした！'. Defeat by Core: the defeat screen says 'アクション・コアが こわれた… / The Core broke…' instead of the HP line. Add CSS only if needed beyond the frozen block, without changing the frozen look.

Tests (new test/core.test.js and/or core-ui test): no Core -> identical behaviour (all existing suites untouched and passing); aim chosen with the intent and stable; core damage uses hero defence (Guard/Barrier reduce, Dodge rules, AP refund on a core heavy); Core at 0 loses with reason 'core' even mid-phase; Core full on retry; waves keep Core HP; charge every 3rd turn only above half; protector protects a core attacker then a boss; repair heals only damaged machines and is telegraphed; Power Slash breaks a core-aimed heavy; UI: the → コア tag, the Core plate, the GUARD THE CORE hint, the Core defeat message. Use a test-only encounter and test-only enemy data defined inside the tests (do not add Higashiosaka enemies to src/battle-data.js).
Add a `?debug=battle` way to see the Core: either a debug-only encounter in the debug launcher or a 'Core' checkbox that adds core: { hp: 30 } to the chosen encounter. Keep it out of Adventure.
Append a dated DESIGN_DECISIONS.md entry for any decision taken while implementing; revise the CURRENT_STATE.md Next Steps line for H1 (done) instead of appending logs.
constraints: Do not edit sprite drawing code (src/pixel-enemies.js, pixel-*.js), src/station-map.js, src/battle-locations.js, or the frozen 'Action Core' CSS block in rpg.css beyond additive rules.
Matsubara, Sakai and Yao behaviour and numbers unchanged: npm run balance output must be byte-identical to before your change (save it first).
Static ES modules, no build step, no framework, no new dependency. Chromebook first: 1024x600 battle with no page scroll.
Edit source with structured edit tools; on the first shell quoting/escaping failure switch to file edit tools.
Do not commit. Do not delete .ai files.
